M054.en: The primary comparison followed five declared workload-eligibility scenarios through perfect-information (PI) planning, independent causal-controller testing, repeated programmes, PV integration and participation costs. Eligibility was the share of offered GPU-hours permitted to wait. Capacity was evaluated against the same delivery and service criteria within each declared call programme.
M054.zh: 主体比较围绕五档声明的工作资格情景，依次评估完全信息（PI）规划、独立因果控制器检验、重复方案、光伏配合及参与成本。资格指投入 GPU 小时中获准等待的份额。每个声明的调用方案均按相同交付与服务标准评估容量。

M057.en: The primary reliability target was 0.95. Capacity was conditional on the controller, workload scenario and call schedule. We selected the largest qualifying candidate on a finite development grid and tested that candidate independently; this procedure does not estimate the continuous maximum of the capacity function. Pointwise probability lower bounds were used for individual offers, without a simultaneous guarantee over all configurations.
M057.zh: 主体可靠性目标为 0.95。容量取决于控制器、工作负载情景和调用安排。我们在有限开发网格中选择通过门槛的最大候选，再独立检验该候选；这一过程不估计容量函数的连续最大值。各项承诺采用逐项概率下界，并未给出覆盖所有配置的联合保证。

M058.en: This extension was specified after the earlier benchmark. One hundred development seeds (930000–930099) selected offers, and 300 previously unexamined confirmation seeds (960000–960299) tested them without reselection. The delivered-power recovery guard and feasible-side action rounding were corrected on development data before this controller version was confirmed. Protocol, source, controller and scenario hashes identify the evidence; original locked certificates remain separate historical results.
M058.zh: 本扩展在此前基准之后制定。100 个开发种子（930000–930099）用于选承诺，300 个此前未查看的确认种子（960000–960299）在不重新选值的条件下检验。实际交付功率的恢复保护及可行侧动作舍入在开发数据上修正后，再对该控制器版本进行确认。协议、来源、控制器和情景哈希标识对应证据；原锁定证书作为独立历史结果保存。

M060.en: Community demand used the End-Use Load Profiles for the US Building Stock,<sup>27,28</sup> combining 75% detached-residence and 25% small-office demand in the mixed 3A profile. These are building-stock simulations calibrated against measurements. Fifteen-minute power was averaged to hourly intervals and scaled to an 800-kW background peak. All five configurations used a common 1,100-kW PCC import rating and prohibited exports. This rating accommodates the unchanged 576-GPU installation across the changing workload mixes; three initial development baselines exceeded the earlier 1,000-kW rating, so the common site rating was amended before formal PI optimisation or controller selection. Those baseline records were retained.
M060.zh: 社区需求采用美国建筑存量的终端用电曲线，<sup>27,28</sup> 在混合 3A 曲线中将 75% 独栋住宅需求与 25% 小型办公需求组合。这些曲线是经测量校准的建筑存量模拟。15 分钟功率平均为小时值，再缩放至 800 kW 背景峰值。五档配置均采用相同的 1,100 kW 公共连接点（PCC）进口容量，并禁止反向送电。该容量适应工作构成变化下保持不变的 576 张 GPU：初始开发基准中有三项超过此前的 1,000 kW 额定值，因此在正式 PI 优化和控制器选值前统一调整站点容量，并保留了这些基准记录。

M061.en: Job shapes came from the Alibaba Serverless Infrastructure execution summary,<sup>29</sup> complementing an earlier public GPU trace.<sup>30</sup> We audited all 40,522,321 released execution spans using requested GPU-equivalents multiplied by uncapped duration. This resource-time denominator retained every workload category; it measures neither energy nor permission to defer work. A reproducible, class-balanced 100,000-record subset supplied low-priority training and offline-inference job shapes. Its balanced record counts were not used to estimate the facility workload mix. Original temporal correlations and production deadlines were unavailable in this summary.
M061.zh: 作业形状来自 Alibaba Serverless Infrastructure 执行摘要，<sup>29</sup> 并与较早公开的 GPU 轨迹相衔接。<sup>30</sup> 我们用申请的 GPU 等效数量乘以未截尾的持续时间，审核全部 40,522,321 条公开执行区段。该资源时间分母保留所有工作类别，既不代表能量，也不代表允许延后的资格。一个可复现、类别均衡的 100,000 条记录子集提供低优先级训练和离线推理的作业形状；均衡记录数量不用于估计设施工作构成。该摘要不能提供原始时间相关性或生产截止时间。

M062.en: Each configuration contained 144 four-GPU nodes and offered 374.4 GPU-h per hour. Let s_c denote a class share and a_c its eligible fraction; total eligibility was \(f = \sum_c s_c a_c\). At f = 0.05, 0.10 and 0.20, a common permission multiplier was applied to the observed low-priority training and offline-inference resource-time shares, which together comprised 0.22028 of the source total. At f = 0.40, additional non-low-priority batch work was assumed to opt in. At f = 0.60, the source mix was explicitly changed by replacing 0.19058 of total work from online to offline inference. Online inference remained ineligible in every case. Flexible GPUs were round(576f), giving approximately 65% mean utilisation in both pools; rigid utilisation used the actual integer remainder.
M062.zh: 每种配置均含 144 个四 GPU 节点，每小时投入 374.4 GPU 小时的工作量。令 s_c 为类别占比，a_c 为该类别获准延后的比例，总资格为 \(f = \sum_c s_c a_c\)。当 f = 0.05、0.10、0.20 时，对原数据中的低优先级训练和离线推理资源时间占比应用同一个获准系数；这两类合计占原始总量的 0.22028。当 f = 0.40 时，假定更多非低优先级批处理也同意参与。当 f = 0.60 时，显式改变原业务构成，将占总工作量 0.19058 的在线推理替换为离线推理。所有情景中的在线推理都没有延后资格。灵活 GPU 数为 round(576f)，使两池平均利用率均约为 65%；刚性利用率按整数 GPU 的实际剩余数量计算。

M070.en: The model assumed PUE 1.2 and 300 W of fixed overhead per node. Training and offline-inference active board power used the measured coefficients of 259.08 and 300.02 W per GPU. Online, development, other and unknown rigid workloads used 300.02 W per active GPU as an engineering proxy, with separate 150- and 225-W controls. These coefficients are not measurements of online serving. Rigid demand was held fixed at its class-weighted mean, so online request latency and burst-level power were not simulated. The hardware measurements constrain the batch-work power conversion, not the representativeness of the workload mix.
M070.zh: 模型假设 PUE 为 1.2，每个节点固定开销为 300 W。训练与离线推理的活动板卡功率分别采用测得的每 GPU 259.08 W 和 300.02 W 系数。在线、开发、其他和未知刚性工作采用每个活动 GPU 300.02 W 的工程代理，并另设 150 W 和 225 W 对照。这些系数不是在线服务的实测功率。刚性需求固定为类别加权均值，因此没有模拟在线请求延迟或突发阶段功率。硬件测量约束的是批处理的功率换算，而非工作构成的代表性。

M079.en: The causal controller retained the six-hour robust MPC, historical-arrival uncertainty envelope and objective weights of the earlier implementation. It observed only released jobs, current queue state and the declared forecast. Its event cap required at least 95% delivery. Because the rebound criterion divides recovery overshoot by actual peak delivered power, the corrected recovery cap used 0.25 × 0.95 × requested power rather than 0.25 × requested power. Continuous actions were rounded towards the feasible side when converted to float32. This electrical cap does not guarantee deadline feasibility. Candidates at 50%, 75%, 90% and 100% of the development PI lower bound were evaluated separately; no monotonicity between candidates was assumed.
M079.zh: 因果控制器保留此前实现中的六小时鲁棒 MPC、历史到达量不确定性包络和目标权重，只观察已释放作业、当前队列状态及声明的预测。事件功率上限要求至少交付 95%。由于反弹指标以实际最大削减功率为分母，修正后的恢复上限采用 0.25 × 0.95 × 承诺功率，而非 0.25 × 承诺功率。连续动作转换为 float32 时向可行一侧舍入。这项电气上限不保证截止时间可行性。开发 PI 下界的 50%、75%、90% 和 100% 候选分别接受检验，不假定候选之间具有单调性。

M081.en: Repeated programmes comprised four four-hour calls with eight-hour gaps, or four eight-hour calls with twelve-hour gaps, starting at hour 63. For each workload configuration, development tested 25%, 50%, 75% and 100% of its selected single-event offer. The rule selected the largest qualifying candidate, if any, for independent confirmation. Regardless of that selection outcome, the original single-event offer was prespecified as a repeated-programme comparator and independently tested. The two programmes do not exhaust possible dispatch schedules.
M081.zh: 重复方案由四次四小时调用、间隔八小时，或四次八小时调用、间隔十二小时组成，首次均从第 63 小时开始。各配置在开发阶段检验已选单次承诺的 25%、50%、75%、100%；若有候选通过，则选择最大者独立确认。无论该选值结果如何，原单次承诺均被预设为重复方案的对照并接受独立检验。这两个方案未穷尽所有调度安排。

M081_r2.en: Matched fresh counterfactuals removed all other calls while preserving the same seed, jobs, community trajectory and clock time. Both the repeated programme and the combination of fresh runs required all four calls to pass. Paired success differences resampled 300 complete scenario seeds 10,000 times. Each complete controlled trajectory was paired with its own no-response baseline for queue, service and economic calculations. Earlier ten-schedule, production-timing and horizon interventions remain separately labelled historical analyses in the archived v0.19 Supplementary Information.
M081_r2.zh: 配对的新事件反事实删除其余调用，同时保持种子、作业、社区轨迹和时刻相同。重复方案与新事件运行的组合都要求四次全部通过。成功率的配对差异对 300 个完整情景种子重采样 10,000 次。每条完整受控轨迹均与自身的无响应基准配对，用于队列、服务和经济核算。此前十种调用安排、生产时序及运行期干预在归档的 v0.19 补充材料中单独标明为历史分析。

M085.en: with imports capped at 1,100 kW and exports prohibited. For each scenario we fixed the GPU installation and maximised PV nameplate subject to at most 5% curtailment, zero missed GPU-hours and at most 2% terminal backlog. BESS supplied 100-kW charge/discharge power and 200-kWh energy, with 0.95 charge and discharge efficiencies and initial and terminal state of charge of 50%. A mixed-integer formulation prohibited simultaneous charging and discharging. All-scenario hosting was the minimum scenario capacity, reported only if every scenario was feasible.
M085.zh: 其中进口功率限制为 1,100 kW，并禁止反向送电。对每个情景，我们固定 GPU 设施规模，在弃光不超过 5%、未按期完成工作为零、末期积压不超过 2% 的条件下最大化光伏额定容量。储能充放电功率为 100 kW、容量为 200 kWh，充电和放电效率均为 0.95，初始与末期荷电状态均为 50%。混合整数公式禁止同时充放电。全情景光伏承载容量取各情景容量的最小值，且仅在所有情景均可行时报告。

M086.en: The utilisation programme fixed PV at 500 kW and retained each configuration's own data-centre power model. Its lexicographic objective first preserved service feasibility and then maximised local PV use within a 10<sup>−5</sup>-kWh tolerance, followed by grid-import and battery-throughput objectives. Rigid and flexible operation were paired under both BESS conditions on the first 100 confirmation seeds. Mean utilisation contrasts used 10,000 paired bootstrap resamples and pointwise 95% intervals. HiGHS<sup>34</sup> used one thread per solve, with independent scenarios parallelised externally. Storage problems retained HiGHS 1.15.1 default relative MIP gap 10<sup>−4</sup> and absolute gap 10<sup>−6</sup>. The 10<sup>−5</sup>-kWh lexicographic lock is not the MIP optimality tolerance. Utilisation contrasts near the roughly 0.01-percentage-point scale associated with that relative gap are not interpreted as resolved storage benefits; paired sampling intervals exclude optimisation uncertainty.
M086.zh: 利用率优化将光伏固定为 500 kW，并保留每种配置自身的数据中心功率模型。词典序目标先保持服务可行，再在 10<sup>−5</sup> kWh 容差内最大化本地光伏利用，之后优化电网进口和电池吞吐量。在前 100 个确认种子上，有/无储能两种条件下的刚性与灵活运行均配对比较。平均利用率差异使用 10,000 次配对自助重采样和逐项 95% 区间。HiGHS<sup>34</sup> 每次求解使用一个线程，并在不同情景之间并行。 储能问题保留 HiGHS 1.15.1 的默认相对 MIP 间隙 10<sup>−4</sup> 和绝对间隙 10<sup>−6</sup>。10<sup>−5</sup> kWh 的词典序锁定不等于 MIP 最优性容差。接近该相对间隙对应的约 0.01 个百分点尺度的利用率差异，不解释为已分辨的储能条件下收益；配对抽样区间不包含优化不确定性。

M088.en: Economic screening used each configuration's development-selected, independently tested four- or eight-hour zero-notice offer. Controlled and no-response trajectories supplied paired energy, delay, deferred work and service outcomes from the first call through the 48-h clearance tail. Performance revenue used non-negative PCC reduction capped at the offer in each event hour. Annual net value retained the following accounting structure; inactive or unmeasured terms were stated explicitly rather than inferred from the hardware measurements:
M088.zh: 经济筛选使用各配置在开发阶段选出、经独立检验的四小时或八小时零通知承诺。受控与无响应轨迹从首次调用开始，一直覆盖至 48 小时清空尾段结束，提供配对的能耗、延迟、推迟工作量及服务结果。履约收入按事件各小时非负的 PCC 削减量计算，并以上报承诺为限。年度净值保留下述核算结构；未启用或未测量的项目明确声明，而不从硬件测量中推断：

M090.en: Reference prices were US$50 per MWh of capped delivered energy, US$0.10 per kWh of incremental electricity and US$0.005 per GPU-h per hour of additional waiting. We solved for the capacity payment making the fifth percentile of 2,000 bootstrap annual net values non-negative. This was a decision statistic, not a confidence interval. Natural-slack participation incurred no reserve or displacement charge. The reserve case annualised 0.15 abstract reserved PCC-side kW per offered kW at US$2,500 per reserved kW, four-year life, 8% discount, 10% salvage and 3% annual operation and maintenance. The displacement case added an assumed US$0.25 per deferred GPU-h; this exposure was distinct from delay cost and was not a measured revenue loss. Connection benefits and checkpoint costs were unpriced; the reference missed-work price was zero. Existing-GPU depreciation was not inferred as an incremental response cost, and the reserve-capital scenario did not model wear or ageing.
M090.zh: 参考价格为：封顶后的交付电量每 MWh 50 美元，增量用电每 kWh 0.10 美元，额外等待每 GPU 小时每小时 0.005 美元。我们求使 2,000 次自助抽样年度净值的第 5 百分位不为负的容量补偿。这是决策统计量，而非置信区间。自然空闲参与不计预留或挤占收费。预留情景按每千瓦承诺对应 0.15 个抽象 PCC 侧预留千瓦进行年化：每预留千瓦投资 2,500 美元、寿命四年、折现率 8%、残值 10%、年运维 3%。挤占情景增加每推迟 GPU 小时 0.25 美元的假定价值暴露；这与延迟成本不同，也不是实测收入损失。 接入收益与检查点成本未定价，参考未完成工作价格为零。没有将既有 GPU 折旧推断为增量响应成本，预留资本情景也不模拟磨损或老化。

M093.en: The fixed site charge was US$25,000 per year and the variable enablement charge was zero. For 1-MW accounting, offered power and physical ledger quantities were multiplied by 1000 divided by the configuration's own operating peak, with the fixed charge applied once and no diversification assumed. This does not certify a 1-MW installation. Annual draws sampled 50 independent single events or 12 independent complete four-call series, retaining failed trajectories. Reserve life, delay price, displaced-value exposure, missed-work price and fixed site cost were sensitivity inputs, not operator estimates. The original external-source register<sup>35–40</sup> provides context for financial ranges, not validation of these scenario prices.
M093.zh: 站点固定费用为每年 25,000 美元，可变启用费用为零。在 1 MW 会计尺度下，将承诺功率与物理账本量同乘以“1000 除以该配置自身运行峰值”，固定费用仅计一次，且不假定风险分散。这不构成对 1 MW 设施的认证。年度抽样选择 50 个独立单次事件，或 12 个独立完整四调用序列，并保留失败轨迹。预留寿命、延迟价格、挤占价值暴露、未完成工作价格和站点固定成本均为敏感性输入，而非运营商估计。原外部来源登记表<sup>35–40</sup> 为财务范围提供背景，并不验证这些情景价格。

M093_series_method.en: Repeated-programme costs were accumulated once per hour over the complete paired series. A programme that did not qualify was identified as such; its conditional cost did not create an eligible offer. Prices of US$0, 0.25 and 1 per missed GPU-h were separately evaluated, and contract-specific non-performance penalties were not priced. Independent annual draws do not reproduce a continuously operating year.
M093_series_method.zh: 重复方案的成本沿完整配对序列逐小时累计，每小时只计一次。未通过资格检验的方案予以明确标识，其条件性成本不产生合格承诺。未完成工作每 GPU 小时 0、0.25 和 1 美元的价格单独评估，合同特定的不履约罚金未定价。独立年度抽样不复现全年连续运行。

M095.en: The five eligibility scenarios used a declared matching rule for GPU allocation and therefore are not a one-factor experiment across the whole range. Two additional controls kept 10% eligibility and the same jobs while assigning 20% or 30% of GPUs to the flexible pool. Two further controls changed only the unmeasured rigid-class active-power proxy to 150 or 225 W. Each control repeated PI planning, the same development-selected fixed requests, PV analysis and economic accounting. Confirmation never retuned the controller or selected new offers for these controls. Earlier broader parameter, regional and joint-share studies are retained with their original workload scope in the archived v0.19 Supplementary Information.
M095.zh: 五档资格情景采用声明的 GPU 匹配分配规则，因此整个范围并不是单因素实验。两个额外对照保持 10% 资格和相同作业，只将 20% 或 30% 的 GPU 分配给灵活池。另两个对照只将未测刚性类别的活动功率代理改为 150 W 或 225 W。每项对照均重做 PI 规划、相同开发承诺的固定请求测试、光伏分析和经济核算。确认阶段不重新调节控制器，也不为这些对照选择新承诺。此前范围更广的参数、地域和联合比例研究在归档的 v0.19 补充材料中按其原始工作负载范围保留。

M096.en: Economic sensitivities recomputed payments from the fixed paired ledgers with common annual draws, without changing physical trajectories or offer selection. They crossed delay prices, site costs and assumed displaced-compute values, and separately varied missed-work prices. Hardware procurement, actual online-service costs and a continuous-year market simulation were not inferred from these screens.
M096.zh: 经济敏感性分析使用固定配对账本和共同年度抽样重新计算补偿，不改变物理轨迹或承诺选择。分析交叉变化延迟价格、站点成本和假定挤占算力价值，并单独变化未完成工作价格。这些筛选不用于推断硬件采购、实际在线服务成本或全年连续市场运行。

M097.en: Independent scenarios were the statistical units; multiple calls within a scenario were not independent replicates. PI lower tolerance limits, Wilson probability lower bounds and paired bootstrap intervals were pointwise. Notice comparisons used exact paired McNemar tests with Holm correction across the 20 comparisons. Hardware intervals retained the original independent-run analysis. Source Data contain per-scenario outcomes, development selection tables, complete paired ledgers and ready-to-plot summaries; hashes link them to the source, protocol and controller versions.
M097.zh: 独立情景是统计单位，同一情景中的多次调用不视为独立重复。PI 容忍下界、Wilson 概率下界及配对自助法区间均为逐项区间。通知比较采用配对精确 McNemar 检验，并对 20 项比较进行 Holm 校正。硬件区间保留原独立运行分析。源数据包含逐情景结果、开发选值表、完整配对账本和可直接绘图的汇总，哈希将其与来源、协议和控制器版本关联。

M010.en: The workload mix sets the first limit on that commitment. Online inference must respond to user requests, whereas some training and offline-inference work can wait within an agreed deadline. Production traces distinguish these classes and their scheduling priorities,<sup>29</sup> but priority is not permission to defer work for grid services. An assessment must therefore specify which jobs are eligible, rather than assigning a fixed flexible fraction to total electricity demand. Eligible jobs must still fit between release and deadline. After a call, postponed work competes with new arrivals; the additional processing obligation relative to operation without response is compute debt.<sup>5,12,18,19</sup> Hardware allocation and recovery rules determine whether that debt can be cleared before the next call.
M010.zh: 工作构成首先限制了这种承诺。在线推理需要及时回应用户请求，部分训练和离线推理则可在约定期限内等待。生产轨迹区分了这些类别及其调度优先级，<sup>29</sup> 但低优先级不等于获准为电网服务而延后。因此，评估必须明确哪些作业有资格，不能给总用电简单指定一个固定可调比例。获准作业仍须在释放与截止时间之间完成。调用之后，推迟的工作与新到达工作竞争；相对于无响应运行增加的未来处理义务称为计算债务。<sup>5,12,18,19</sup> 硬件分配和恢复规则决定这些债务能否在下次调用前清除。

M012.en: Here we assess data-centre power commitments across declared workload compositions, following each configuration through service qualification, repeated dispatch, PV integration and participation costs. We audit the resource-time composition of a production execution summary and construct scenarios in which 5%, 10% or 20% of offered work may wait. Two higher-share comparisons, 40% and 60%, expose the additional permission and business-composition assumptions needed to obtain larger flexibility. AIDRBench combines these trace-informed job shapes with four-GPU power measurements and a modelled community electricity system. Full-information schedules quantify planning potential; independent causal-controller tests assess delivery. Separate controls distinguish the effects of GPU allocation and unmeasured rigid-load power. The analysis connects an explicit workload assumption to its downstream capacity, grid benefit and participation cost.
M012.zh: 本文在明确声明的工作构成下评估数据中心功率承诺，对每种配置贯通服务资格、重复调用、光伏配合与参与成本。我们审计生产执行摘要的资源时间构成，建立总投入工作中 5%、10% 或 20% 可以等待的情景；再用 40% 和 60% 两项高比例对照，展示更大灵活性所需的额外授权和业务构成假设。AIDRBench 将受轨迹启发的作业形状、四 GPU 功率测量与模拟社区电力系统结合。完整未来信息下的调度量化规划潜力，独立因果控制器测试评估交付；另设对照区分 GPU 分配和未测刚性功率的影响。这项分析把明确的工作负载假设连接到其下游容量、电网收益和参与成本。

M014.en: ### Workload composition limits which computing can support a commitment
M014.zh: ### 工作构成限制了哪些计算可以支持响应承诺

M015.en: We first examined what fraction of computing could plausibly enter the deferrable pool. Across 40.52 million execution spans in the released Alibaba summary,<sup>29</sup> online inference accounted for 54.5% of requested GPU-hours, offline inference for 21.5% and training for 19.4% (Fig. 1a). Low-priority training and offline inference together accounted for 22.0%. These are descriptive resource-time shares, not measured energy shares or demand-response permissions. They provide a candidate pool from which an operator might authorise a smaller amount of work to wait.
M015.zh: 我们首先检查有多少计算可能进入可延后工作池。在 Alibaba 公开摘要的 4,052 万个执行区段中，<sup>29</sup> 在线推理占申请 GPU 小时的 54.5%，离线推理占 21.5%，训练占 19.4%（图 1a）。低优先级训练与离线推理合计占 22.0%。这些是资源时间的描述性占比，不是实测能耗占比或需求响应授权；它们提供候选范围，运营商可能从中允许较少部分工作等待。

M016.en: The primary low-share scenarios allowed 5%, 10% or 20% of total offered work to be deferred, preserving the observed class mix and varying permission within low-priority batch work. The 40% comparison required almost all training and offline inference to opt in. Reaching 60% required a different business mix: 19.1 percentage points of total work were reassigned from online to offline inference before batch work was made eligible (Fig. 1b). Online jobs remained ineligible in every scenario. Thus, the two larger fractions describe additional operational assumptions, rather than evidence that a typical inference-led facility can defer most of its load.
M016.zh: 主体低比例情景允许总投入工作量的 5%、10% 或 20% 延后，保持观察到的类别构成，只改变低优先级批处理中的获准份额。40% 对照需要几乎全部训练和离线推理都同意参与。达到 60% 则需要不同业务构成：先将总工作量的 19.1 个百分点从在线推理改为离线推理，再赋予批处理延后资格（图 1b）。所有情景中的在线作业均无此资格。因此，两个高比例描述的是额外运行假设，不能证明典型的推理主导设施能够延后大部分负荷。

M017.en: All five configurations retained 576 GPUs and 374.4 GPU-h of offered work per hour. We assigned the same approximate fraction of GPUs as work to the flexible pool, keeping mean utilisation near 65% in both pools. This declared allocation policy avoids interpreting a severely overloaded or largely idle pool as the reference operating condition. It also means that the five-way comparison changes eligibility together with its supporting allocation; controls at 10% eligibility isolate allocation separately (Fig. 5; Supplementary Table 8).
M017.zh: 五种配置均保留 576 张 GPU 和每小时 374.4 GPU 小时的投入工作量。灵活池 GPU 比例与其承接的工作比例大致相同，使两池平均利用率维持在约 65%。这一明确的分配规则避免将严重过载或大部分闲置的池当作参考运行条件。同时，五档比较改变的是资格及其配套分配；在 10% 资格下另设对照，单独识别分配的影响（图 5；补充表 8）。

M019.en: Measured board power constrained the batch-work conversion: four-GPU training and offline inference averaged 259.08 and 300.02 W per GPU, with a held-out mean absolute prediction error of 3.80 W (Supplementary Fig. 2). Online and other rigid workloads required a separate engineering power proxy, tested in sensitivity controls. The measurements therefore supported the scheduling-to-power calculation without establishing the workload mix or the power of online serving.
M019.zh: 实测板卡功率约束了批处理工作量到用电的换算：四 GPU 训练与离线推理平均每 GPU 为 259.08 W 和 300.02 W，留出测试的平均绝对预测误差为 3.80 W（补充图 2）。在线及其他刚性工作需要另设工程功率代理，并通过对照检查。测量因此支持调度到功率的换算，但不能证明工作构成或在线服务功率。

M050.en: For an operator, the assessment begins with an inventory of work that is contractually permitted to wait, together with the hardware and deadlines available to complete it. A capacity and call schedule can then be selected and independently tested before local grid benefits and participation costs are assessed. This is consistent with capacity assessment for other resources whose actions are coupled over time.<sup>25,26</sup> Changing the workload mix requires the downstream calculations to be repeated; a sensitivity curve for planning potential alone cannot establish the reliability or economics of a different operating configuration.
M050.zh: 对运营商而言，评估应先盘点合同允许等待的工作，以及完成它所需的硬件和截止时间。随后选择容量与调用安排，进行独立检验，再评估本地电网收益和参与成本。这与其他跨时段相互制约资源的容量评估相一致。<sup>25,26</sup> 工作构成改变之后，必须重做下游计算；单有规划潜力的敏感性曲线，不能证明另一种运行配置的可靠性或经济性。

M051.en: These numerical results remain conditional model evidence. Requested GPU-hours from one production infrastructure are not energy measurements or an industry workload census. Deferral permission and deadlines were assumed; hourly divisible jobs, constant rigid demand and a small board-power calibration do not reproduce online latency, checkpoint overhead or facility response. The 40% and 60% cases add unverified participation and business-composition assumptions. The repeated tests cover two four-call schedules followed by a clearance tail, and annual costs sample independent episodes rather than a continuous year. Actual GPU procurement, ageing and contractual failure penalties require operator data. These limitations constrain numerical transfer while leaving the five-scenario comparisons reproducible.
M051.zh: 这些数值仍是有条件的模型证据。单个生产基础设施的申请 GPU 小时不是能耗测量或行业工作负载普查。延后授权和截止时间为假设；小时级可分割作业、恒定刚性需求及小规模板卡校准，不能复现在线延迟、检查点开销或设施响应。40% 和 60% 情景增加了未经验证的参与和业务构成假设。重复测试覆盖两种四调用安排及之后的清空尾段，年度成本抽样独立情景，未模拟连续全年。真实 GPU 采购、老化及合同违约罚金需要运营商数据。这些限制约束了数值外推，同时保留五档比较的可复现性。

M074.en: where \(\Delta B_{c,t}\) is controlled minus baseline backlog in GPU-h, board powers are in W and compute debt is in kWh. Recovery and rebound were evaluated over the declared post-event window, with the clearance tail used to assess terminal backlog. For requested reduction R, delivered power was \(\Delta P_t=\max(0,P^{\mathrm{baseline}}_t-P^{\mathrm{control}}_t)\). Mean event delivery, \(\sum_{t\in E}\min(\Delta P_t,R)/(R|E|)\), had to reach 0.95, and every event hour also had to satisfy
M074.zh: 其中 \(\Delta B_{c,t}\) 为受控减基准积压，单位 GPU 小时；板卡功率单位为 W，计算债务单位为 kWh。在声明的事件后窗口评估恢复与反弹，清空尾段用于评估末期积压。对于请求削减 R，交付功率为 \(\Delta P_t=\max(0,P^{\mathrm{baseline}}_t-P^{\mathrm{control}}_t)\)。平均事件交付 \(\sum_{t\in E}\min(\Delta P_t,R)/(R|E|)\) 必须达到 0.95，且每个事件小时还须满足

M078.en: The PI programme maximised R separately for each scenario. We summarised these maxima using an exact-binomial nonparametric tolerance lower bound at reliability 0.95 and confidence 0.95.<sup>31</sup> With 100 scenarios, the second-smallest optimum supported this statement with achieved confidence 0.96292. The selected controller offers were independently tested using one-sided 95% Wilson probability lower bounds;<sup>32,33</sup> qualification required a lower bound of at least 0.95. This probability concerns all delivery and service criteria together.
M078.zh: PI 程序分别最大化各情景的 R，再用可靠性 0.95、置信度 0.95 的精确二项非参数容忍下界汇总。<sup>31</sup> 在 100 个情景下，第二小的最优值以实际 0.96292 的置信度支持该陈述。所选控制器承诺采用单侧 95% Wilson 概率下界独立检验，<sup>32,33</sup> 资格要求下界至少 0.95。这项概率对应所有交付与服务标准同时满足。

M099.en: Community demand was obtained from the NREL End-Use Load Profiles through the OEDI building-stock data lake.<sup>27,28</sup> Workload records came from the official Alibaba cluster-trace-gpu-v2026 release.<sup>29</sup> Retrieval locations, preprocessing records and original input hashes are listed in data/manifests/sources.yaml. Raw third-party releases are accessed from their original providers. The accompanying Source Data bundle contains the full class-composition audit, scenario and controller identities, development selection, all trial-level outcomes, complete development and confirmation trajectories and paired economic ledgers, renewable optimisation results, calibration inputs and ready-to-plot tables. CSV and Parquet files have data dictionaries and SHA-256 manifests. Earlier benchmark outputs are preserved in a separately labelled archive. Public archival deposition of this revised bundle remains pending at [ZENODO DOI TO BE ADDED].
M099.zh: 社区需求来自 NREL 通过 OEDI 建筑存量数据湖提供的终端用电曲线。<sup>27,28</sup> 工作记录来自 Alibaba 官方 cluster-trace-gpu-v2026 发布。<sup>29</sup> 检索位置、预处理记录与原始输入哈希列于 data/manifests/sources.yaml；第三方原始发布从原提供方获取。随附源数据包包含完整类别构成审计、情景及控制器标识、开发选值、所有试验级结果、完整开发与确认轨迹与配对经济账本、可再生能源优化结果、校准输入和可直接绘图的表格。CSV 与 Parquet 配有数据字典及 SHA-256 清单。此前基准输出保存在单独标明的归档中。本修订包的公开归档存储仍待完成：[ZENODO DOI TO BE ADDED]。

M101.en: The AIDRBench project is hosted at https://github.com/daxiang415/AIDRBench. The accompanying revision bundle includes the exact study drivers, corrected-controller implementation, frozen protocols, analysis scripts and standalone Python redraw commands used here. Public archival release of the revised submission code and its software licence remain pending author confirmation; no new release DOI is claimed.
M101.zh: AIDRBench 项目位于 https://github.com/daxiang415/AIDRBench。随附修订包提供本研究所用的精确运行程序、修正控制器实现、冻结协议、分析脚本和独立 Python 重绘命令。修订投稿代码的公开归档发布及软件许可证仍待作者确认，未声称已获得新的发布 DOI。

M006.en: Artificial-intelligence data centres could support electricity grids by postponing computing, but online services limit how much work operators can allow to wait. Here we connect explicit workload permissions to response capacity, repeated delivery, photovoltaic integration and participation costs. An audit of production resource time identifies low-priority training and offline inference as a candidate pool, without treating priority as permission. In scenarios allowing 5–20% of total work to wait, independently tested four- and eight-hour offers are 2.95–11.80 kW for modelled operating peaks of 190–200 kW. Larger 40% and 60% comparisons require broader participation or a changed business mix. Reusing single-event offers passed the confirmation criterion for four-hour calls with eight-hour gaps, but failed for eight-hour calls with twelve-hour gaps; the separate development search selected no repeated candidate. Renewable benefits and compensation are recalculated for every configuration. Lower eligibility limits offered power and concentrates fixed participation costs on fewer kilowatts. Workload permission and call schedule must therefore accompany claims about data-centre flexibility.
M006.zh: 人工智能数据中心可通过推迟计算支持电网，但在线服务限制了运营商能够允许等待的工作量。本文将明确的工作授权与响应容量、重复交付、光伏配合及参与成本连接起来。对生产资源时间的审计将低优先级训练和离线推理识别为候选池，但不把低优先级当作延后权限。在允许总工作量 5%–20% 等待的情景中，对应模型运行峰值为 190–200 kW，经独立检验的四小时和八小时承诺为 2.95–11.80 kW。40% 和 60% 的更高比例需要扩大参与范围或改变业务构成。重复使用单次承诺，在四小时调用、八小时间隔下通过确认标准，在八小时调用、十二小时间隔下则未通过；另行开展的开发搜索未选出重复候选。每种配置均重新计算可再生能源收益与补偿。较低资格限制承诺功率，也使固定参与费用集中于更少千瓦。因此，数据中心灵活性陈述必须附带工作授权和调用安排。

M021.en: ### Smaller eligible pools support smaller independently tested offers
M021.zh: ### 较小的合格工作池支持较小的独立检验承诺

M022.en: Limiting eligible work constrained the response. Under perfect information (PI), where the scheduler knows all future arrivals, four-hour planning lower bounds were 2.89, 5.78 and 11.56 kW at 5%, 10% and 20% eligibility. Development-selected offers of 2.95, 5.90 and 11.80 kW then qualified on 300 independent scenarios, corresponding to 1.6–5.9% of the configurations' operating peaks (Fig. 2a; Supplementary Table 4). The 40% and 60% comparisons qualified at 22.19 and 34.00 kW under their additional assumptions. The proportional low-share response follows the shared job-template scaling and allocation policy; it is not an empirically established linear law for production facilities.
M022.zh: 限制获准工作量也限制了响应。在完全信息（PI，即调度器事先知道所有未来到达工作）条件下，5%、10%、20% 资格的四小时规划下界为 2.89、5.78、11.56 kW；开发选出的 2.95、5.90、11.80 kW 承诺随后在 300 个独立情景中通过资格检验，相当于各配置运行峰值的 1.6%–5.9%（图 2a；补充表 4）。40% 和 60% 对照在其额外假设下分别合格于 22.19 和 34.00 kW。低比例区间的比例关系来自共同作业模板缩放及分配规则，不是生产设施中经实证确认的线性规律。

M023.en: The same selected power qualified at four and eight hours on this finite grid, but longer events reduced observed success from 295/300 to 292/300 in every configuration. The one-sided 95% probability lower bounds were 0.9662 and 0.9533, respectively. Zero-, two- and six-hour notice produced identical paired success outcomes (Fig. 2b). In this model, jobs cannot execute before release and the no-response reference already processes available work eagerly. Advance information therefore does not establish additional pre-executable work. The fixed-request result does not rule out notice benefits under another baseline schedule, workload release pattern or controller.
M023.zh: 在该有限网格内，相同承诺功率同时通过四小时和八小时检验，但较长事件使各配置的观察成功数从 295/300 降为 292/300，单侧 95% 概率下界分别为 0.9662 和 0.9533。提前零、二、六小时通知的配对成功结果完全一致（图 2b）。模型不允许作业在释放前执行，无响应参考也已尽早处理可用工作，因此提前获得信息并不自动增加可提前执行的工作。固定请求的结果不能排除其他基准调度、释放模式或控制器下的通知收益。

M025.en: ### Repeated delivery depends on the call programme
M025.zh: ### 重复交付取决于具体调用安排

M026.en: Call history reduced reliability for the longer service. At 10% eligibility and the same 5.90-kW request, four four-hour calls with eight-hour gaps succeeded in all 300 confirmation scenarios, matching four isolated calls at the same clock times. Four eight-hour calls with twelve-hour gaps instead succeeded in 256/300 scenarios, compared with 297/300 for the isolated calls. The paired difference was -13.7 percentage points (95% interval, -17.7 to -9.7). Both conditions required all four calls to pass; Fig. 3 and Supplementary Table 5 report every workload configuration.
M026.zh: 调用历史降低了较长服务的可靠性。在 10% 资格、相同 5.90 kW 请求下，四次四小时调用、间隔八小时，在全部 300 个确认情景中成功，与相同时刻分别运行的四次独立调用一致。四次八小时调用、间隔十二小时，则只有 256/300 成功，独立调用为 297/300。配对差异为 -13.7 个百分点（95% 区间 -17.7 至 -9.7）。两种条件都要求四次调用全部通过；五档工作配置均见图 3 和补充表 5。

M027.en: Across all five configurations, the prespecified original offers passed the four-hour repeated confirmation criterion (300/300; probability lower bound 0.9911), whereas eight-hour repeated success ranged from 241/300 to 268/300 and failed the criterion. Separately, the 100-scenario development search over 25%, 50%, 75% and 100% of each offer selected no repeated candidate: even its best observed success, 98/100, gave a lower bound of 0.9414. The successful four-hour confirmation is therefore evidence for the prespecified comparator, not a retrospectively selected candidate under the two-stage rule. Event-and-recovery peak-relief failures persisted at reduced requests; these electrical failures do not by themselves establish lost GPU work. The tests distinguish two schedules and do not imply zero repeated capacity.
M027.zh: 五档配置的预设原承诺均通过四小时重复方案的确认标准（300/300，概率下界 0.9911），而八小时重复成功数为 241/300 至 268/300，均未通过。另行在 100 个开发情景中搜索各承诺的 25%、50%、75%、100%，没有选出重复候选：即使最好的观察成功数 98/100，下界也只有 0.9414。因此，四小时确认成功支持的是预设对照，不能事后把它改称为按两阶段规则选出的候选。降低请求后仍出现事件及恢复窗口的峰值削减失败；这些电气失败本身不能证明 GPU 工作损失。检验区分了两种安排，不意味着重复容量为零。

M029.en: ### Workload eligibility changes both PV hosting and local utilisation
M029.zh: ### 工作资格改变光伏承载与本地利用

M030.en: With the 576-GPU installation fixed, flexibility increased all-scenario PV hosting by 2.82, 5.40 and 10.36 kW at 5%, 10% and 20% eligibility without BESS. At 10%, the gain with BESS was 5.22 kW (Fig. 4a; Supplementary Table 6). These capacities were feasible across all 100 paired confirmation scenarios under at most 5% curtailment and zero deadline misses. Each configuration used its own power model and the same 1,100-kW PCC rating, enabling paired comparisons at a fixed GPU installation.
M030.zh: 固定 576 张 GPU 时，在无储能条件下，5%、10%、20% 资格的灵活性分别使全情景光伏承载增加 2.82、5.40、10.36 kW。10% 资格配储能时增加 5.22 kW（图 4a；补充表 6）。这些容量在全部 100 个配对确认情景中均满足弃光不超过 5% 且截止时间损失为零。各配置使用自身功率模型及共同的 1,100 kW PCC 限制，在固定 GPU 设施下进行配对比较。

M031.en: For a fixed 500-kW PV installation, the 10% case increased local utilisation by only 0.0057 percentage points without BESS (95% paired interval, 0.0019–0.0106). With BESS, the reported difference was below 0.0001 percentage points and was not resolved at the configured mixed-integer optimisation precision (Fig. 4b). Small signed storage contrasts are retained in the data; sampling intervals do not include optimisation error. This energy-fraction metric answers a different question from additional installed kilowatts. Storage and flexible work therefore require evaluation within the same local model.
M031.zh: 对于固定 500 kW 光伏装置，10% 资格在无储能时使本地利用率仅提高 0.0057 个百分点（95% 配对区间 0.0019–0.0106）。有储能时，报告差异小于 0.0001 个百分点，未达到当前混合整数求解精度下可分辨的水平（图 4b）。源数据保留有储能时的微小正负差异；抽样区间不包含优化误差。这一电量比例指标与新增安装千瓦回答不同问题，储能与灵活工作因此需要在同一本地模型中联合评估。

M032.en: These renewable results use full future information, zero missed-work allowance and separately optimised schedules. They establish conditional planning benefits, not a demonstration that the causal demand-response controller achieves the same PV outcomes. The larger eligibility comparisons retain their additional participation or business-composition assumptions throughout the renewable analysis.
M032.zh: 这些可再生能源结果采用完整未来信息、零未完成工作额度及单独优化的调度。它们给出有条件的规划收益，不能证明因果需求响应控制器达到了相同光伏结果。高资格对照在整个可再生能源分析中仍附带其额外参与或业务构成假设。

M034.en: ### GPU allocation and rigid-load power affect different parts of the assessment
M034.zh: ### GPU 分配与刚性功率影响评估的不同部分

M035.en: At fixed 10% eligibility, increasing the flexible GPU allocation from 10% to 20% or 30% left the four- and eight-hour PI bounds at 5.78 and 5.57 kW (Fig. 5a). The unchanged 5.90-kW controller offer also retained 295/300 and 292/300 successes. Extra processing headroom did not supply extra eligible arrivals at the call time. This isolates the allocation effect around the low-eligibility configuration and prevents the primary matching rule from being mistaken for a pure eligibility-only experiment.
M035.zh: 固定 10% 资格时，将灵活 GPU 分配由 10% 增至 20% 或 30%，四/八小时 PI 下界仍为 5.78 和 5.57 kW（图 5a）。不变的 5.90 kW 控制器承诺也保持 295/300 和 292/300 的成功数。额外处理余量没有增加调用时已释放的合格工作。这一对照在低资格配置附近单独识别分配影响，避免将主体匹配规则误认为纯资格单因素实验。

M036.en: Reducing the unmeasured rigid-class active-power proxy from 300 to 225 or 150 W per GPU also left these baseline-relative offers and success counts unchanged (Fig. 5b; Supplementary Fig. 4). The proxy instead changed the operating-peak coefficient from 193.44 to 173.53 or 153.63 kW. Constant rigid consumption cancels in the paired reduction, but it remains part of facility demand, PV integration and proportional economic accounting. An unchanged response estimate therefore does not make the rigid-power assumption irrelevant.
M036.zh: 将未测刚性类别的活动功率代理由每 GPU 300 W 降至 225 W 或 150 W，也没有改变这些相对基准的承诺及成功数（图 5b；补充图 4），但运行峰值系数从 193.44 kW 降至 173.53 或 153.63 kW。恒定刚性用电在配对削减量中相消，却仍影响设施需求、光伏配合及按比例经济核算。因此，响应估计不变并不意味着刚性功率假设无关。

M037.en: Allocation nevertheless changed local grid value: assigning 20% of GPUs to the flexible pool increased the no-BESS PV hosting gain from 5.40 to 24.99 kW at unchanged 10% work eligibility (Supplementary Fig. 4). Cost controls retained each configuration's complete ledger and its own operating peak (Fig. 5c,d; Supplementary Table 8). At the proportional 1-MW accounting scale, a changed peak also changes the number of reference modules represented; these cost contrasts do not measure GPU procurement. The selected controls do not cover simultaneous changes in arrival correlations, deadlines, online-serving dynamics and all prices.
M037.zh: 分配仍改变了本地电网价值：工作资格维持 10%，将 20% GPU 分给灵活池，使无储能光伏承载增量由 5.40 增至 24.99 kW（补充图 4）。成本对照保留各配置完整账本及自身运行峰值（图 5c、d；补充表 8）。在按比例换算的 1 MW 会计尺度下，峰值变化也改变所代表的参考模块数量；这些成本差异不测量 GPU 采购。选定对照未覆盖到达相关性、截止时间、在线服务动态与全部价格的同时变化。

M039.en: ### Low eligibility concentrates fixed participation costs on fewer offered kilowatts
M039.zh: ### 低资格使固定参与成本集中于更少承诺千瓦

M040.en: We next priced each independently qualified single-event offer using its own response and no-response trajectories through recovery. Annual compensation was the payment per offered kilowatt required to make the fifth percentile of net value non-negative under specified energy, waiting and participation costs. Natural slack, reserved headroom and assumed displaced-value exposure describe different costs of providing the same electrical offer (Fig. 6). They are scenarios for screening participation, not measured operator profits.
M040.zh: 随后用各自贯穿恢复期的响应与无响应轨迹，为每个独立合格的单次承诺核算价格。年度补偿为在指定能耗、等待和参与成本下，使净值第 5 百分位不为负所需的每承诺千瓦费用。自然空闲、预留容量与假定挤占价值暴露，描述同一电气承诺的不同供给成本（图 6）。它们用于参与筛选，不是实测运营商利润。

M041.en: At a proportional 1-MW accounting scale, 50 independent four-hour calls per year and a US$25,000 annual site charge, slack-participation thresholds were US$1653.07, 863.26 and 468.04 per offered kW-year at 5%, 10% and 20% eligibility. For 10%, reserved headroom raised the threshold to US$979.40, and assumed displaced value raised it to US$1003.51 (Fig. 6a; Supplementary Table 7). The 1-MW conversion scales the paired ledger and offered power; it does not certify a 1-MW installation.
M041.zh: 在按比例换算的 1 MW 会计尺度、每年 50 个独立四小时调用及 25,000 美元站点年费下，5%、10%、20% 资格的自然空闲参与门槛分别为每承诺 kW 每年 1653.07、863.26、468.04 美元。10% 资格下，预留容量使门槛升至 979.40 美元，假定挤占价值使其升至 1003.51 美元（图 6a；补充表 7）。1 MW 换算按比例缩放配对账本与承诺功率，不认证 1 MW 设施。

M042.en: The low-share cases deliver less total power while sharing the same site charge. This fixed-cost denominator explains why a smaller eligible pool can require a higher payment per offered kilowatt even though less work is postponed. At 10%, extending calls from four to eight hours changed the slack threshold from US$863.26 to US$949.73 per kW-year at the same selected power (Fig. 6b). Duration therefore changes the cost of the service even when the finite candidate grid selects the same capacity.
M042.zh: 低比例情景提供的总功率较少，却承担相同站点费用。这一固定成本分母解释了为何合格池较小时，即使推迟工作较少，每承诺千瓦仍可能需要更高补偿。10% 资格下，承诺功率不变，将调用从四小时延长到八小时，使自然空闲门槛从每 kW 每年 863.26 变为 949.73 美元（图 6b）。因此，即使有限网格选出相同容量，时长仍会改变服务成本。

M043.en: At 10% eligibility, changing the waiting price from zero to twice its reference value moved the four-hour slack threshold from US$810.73 to US$915.95 per kW-year. Fixed site charges, assumed displaced values, missed-work prices and reserve life were also varied (Supplementary Fig. 5; Supplementary Table 9). The reserve-life calculation is an accounting sensitivity, not a measurement of GPU ageing or a substitute for procurement data.
M043.zh: 10% 资格下，将等待价格从零调至参考值的两倍，四小时自然空闲门槛由每 kW 每年 810.73 美元变为 915.95 美元。另改变站点固定费、假定挤占价值、未完成工作价格与预留寿命（补充图 5；补充表 9）。预留寿命计算属于会计敏感性，不是 GPU 老化测量，也不能替代采购数据。

M043_series.en: Repeated-programme ledgers retained every hour once across all four calls and the clearance tail, including failed trajectories. Their conditional prices are shown for all five configurations at twelve independent series per year (Fig. 6c). Filled markers identify original offers passing the four-hour confirmation criterion; crosses identify the eight-hour failures. Neither price changes the separate finding that the development rule selected no repeated candidate. Non-performance penalties are unpriced, and independent series do not represent a continuously operating year.
M043_series.zh: 重复方案账本将四次调用及清空尾段中的每小时仅计一次，并保留失败轨迹。五档均给出每年十二个独立序列下的条件价格（图 6c）。实心标记表示通过四小时确认标准的原承诺，叉号表示八小时未通过。两种价格都不改变开发规则没有选出重复候选这一独立结果。不履约罚金未定价，独立序列也不代表连续全年运行。

M046.en: The main implication is that a workload assumption must travel with its downstream conclusions. Explicitly limiting permission to 5–20% of offered work produced single-event offers of only 2.95–11.80 kW in this model. Larger values required broader batch participation or a changed business mix. This connects production workload characterisation<sup>29</sup> to the commitment question raised by field demonstrations<sup>2</sup> and scheduling studies,<sup>4–17</sup> without treating a candidate low-priority pool as an observed demand-response resource.
M046.zh: 主要启示是，工作负载假设必须与下游结论始终对应。将获准份额明确限制在总投入工作的 5%–20%，本模型的单次承诺仅为 2.95–11.80 kW。更大数值需要扩大批处理参与或改变业务构成。这将生产工作负载刻画<sup>29</sup>与现场示范<sup>2</sup>及调度研究<sup>4–17</sup>提出的承诺问题连接起来，同时避免将低优先级候选池当作已观察到的需求响应资源。

M047.en: Repeated operation exposed the limits of transferring a single-event certificate. The four-hour programme passed independent confirmation at the original offer, whereas the eight-hour programme did not. The development grid nevertheless selected no repeated candidate, demonstrating that the prespecified selection outcome and a successful independent comparator test must be reported separately. Peak relief over event-and-recovery windows remained a limiting electrical condition even at reduced requests. These failures do not justify attributing every unsuccessful programme to lost computing work or inferring a universal derating factor. A different controller, finer capacity search or revised schedule would require a new independent test.
M047.zh: 重复运行暴露了单次证书迁移的限制。四小时方案在原承诺下通过独立确认，八小时方案则未通过；开发网格仍未选出重复候选，说明必须分别报告预设选值规则的结果与独立对照检验成功。即使请求降低，事件及恢复窗口峰值削减仍是限制性的电气条件。这些失败不能支持把所有未成功方案归因于计算工作损失，也不能据此推断通用降额系数。不同控制器、更细容量搜索或改变安排，都需要新的独立检验。

M048.en: Workload permission also changed the local planning and accounting context. Hosting additional PV and increasing the use of an installed system require different calculations, and battery storage changes both opportunities. Their values cannot be added independently.<sup>20–24</sup> Likewise, a constant rigid-power term can cancel in baseline-relative response while still affecting the facility peak, grid integration and economic scaling.
M048.zh: 工作授权也改变本地规划和会计背景。新增光伏承载与提高已安装系统的利用需要不同计算，电池储能会改变两种机会，不能将它们的价值独立相加。<sup>20–24</sup> 同样，恒定刚性功率项可在相对基准的响应中相消，却仍影响设施峰值、电网配合及经济缩放。

M049.en: Lower eligibility concentrates fixed site costs on a smaller offer. Reserved headroom and hypothetical displaced value can add further charges, while longer calls increase waiting exposure. The complete ledgers make these mechanisms recalculable at other prices. They do not establish actual GPU wear, operator revenue loss or profitability, and a low conditional price cannot compensate for an unqualified repeated programme. Technical qualification remains a prerequisite for interpreting a participation threshold as an offerable option.
M049.zh: 较低资格使固定站点成本集中于更小承诺。预留容量和假定挤占价值可增加收费，较长调用则增加等待暴露。完整账本使这些机制可在其他价格下重新计算，但不能证明真实 GPU 磨损、运营商收入损失或盈利；较低条件价格也不能弥补重复方案不合格。将参与门槛解释为可报价选项之前，技术资格仍是前提。

M150.en: ### Figure 1 | Workload composition and declared permission to defer
M150.zh: ### 图 1 | 工作构成与声明的延后权限

M151.en: **a,** Requested GPU-hour shares from all 40,522,321 released execution spans, using uncapped duration. The denominator includes online inference, offline inference, training, development, other and unknown work. These are descriptive source totals, not energy shares or an industry estimate. **b,** Training and offline-inference contributions to each eligibility scenario. At 5–20%, a common fraction of low-priority batch work is permitted to wait. The 40% case assumes nearly all batch work opts in; the 60% case replaces 19.058 percentage points of online work with offline work before granting eligibility. Online jobs are never deferred. Source Data retain class-by-priority totals and full-precision scenario definitions.
M151.zh: **a，**采用未截尾时长统计全部 40,522,321 个公开执行区段的申请 GPU 小时份额。分母包含在线推理、离线推理、训练、开发、其他和未知工作。这是源数据总量的描述，不是能耗份额或行业估计。**b，**每档资格中训练与离线推理的贡献。5%–20% 对低优先级批处理采用共同获准等待比例；40% 假定几乎全部批处理同意参与；60% 先将总工作量的 19.058 个百分点由在线替换为离线，再授予资格。在线作业始终不延后。源数据保留类别与优先级交叉汇总及完整精度的情景定义。

M152.en: ### Figure 2 | Planning capacity and independently tested single offers
M152.zh: ### 图 2 | 规划容量与独立检验的单次承诺

M153.en: **a,** PI lower tolerance bounds from 100 confirmation scenarios (95% reliability, at least 95% confidence; horizontal marks) and development-selected controller offers (circles; crosses would denote failure to qualify). The two statistics use different constructions and their relative ordering does not imply an information advantage. **b,** Success fractions at the same request under 0-, 2- and 6-h notice, with one-sided 95% Wilson lower limits and 300 independent seeds per condition. Dashed line, 95% qualification threshold. Blue and green identify four- and eight-hour events; shapes distinguish notice. Complete paired outcomes and Holm-adjusted exact McNemar tests are provided. In all ratio plots, * denotes nearly all-batch opt-in at 40%, and † denotes changed business composition at 60%.
M153.zh: **a，**由 100 个确认情景得到的 PI 容忍下界（可靠性 95%、置信度至少 95%；横标），以及开发选出的控制器承诺（圆点；若未通过资格则为叉号）。两项统计构造不同，其高低不表示信息优势。**b，**固定同一请求、提前 0、2、6 小时通知的成功比例，附单侧 95% Wilson 下界；每个条件含 300 个独立种子。虚线为 95% 资格门槛。蓝、绿分别表示四小时和八小时，形状区分通知。完整配对结果及 Holm 校正的精确 McNemar 检验见源数据。所有比例图中，* 表示 40% 需要几乎全部批处理同意参与，† 表示 60% 改变业务构成。

M154.en: ### Figure 3 | Repeated-programme confirmation and development selection
M154.zh: ### 图 3 | 重复方案的确认与开发选择

M155.en: **a,b,** All-four-call success for four-hour calls with eight-hour gaps and eight-hour calls with twelve-hour gaps. Grey bars combine four isolated calls at the same clock times; blue bars carry the queue through all four calls. Both conditions use the original selected single-event offer. Bars show observed success and one-sided 95% Wilson lower limits across 300 paired complete scenario seeds. Paired difference intervals are in Supplementary Table 5. **c,d,** One-sided 95% Wilson lower bounds for all four development candidates, expressed as fractions of the single-event offer, on 100 development seeds. The dashed 95% target was not reached by any candidate. This selection outcome is separate from confirmation of the prespecified original offer; it does not imply zero physical repeated capacity. The two programmes retain their own gaps and do not estimate a general gap-response curve.
M155.zh: **a、b，**四小时调用/八小时间隔及八小时调用/十二小时间隔的四次全成功比例。灰柱将相同时刻的四个单独调用组合，蓝柱将队列贯穿四次调用；两者均采用原已选单次承诺。柱为观察成功比例，附 300 个配对完整情景种子的单侧 95% Wilson 下界；配对差异区间见补充表 5。**c、d，**全部四个开发候选（以单次承诺的比例表示）在 100 个开发种子上的单侧 95% Wilson 下界。没有候选达到虚线标出的 95% 目标。这项选值结果与预设原承诺的确认结果分开，不能据此推断物理重复容量为零。两个方案各自保留其间隔，未估计一般的间隔响应曲线。

M156.en: ### Figure 4 | PV hosting and utilisation across eligibility scenarios
M156.zh: ### 图 4 | 不同资格下的光伏承载与利用率

M157.en: **a,** Flexible-minus-rigid all-scenario PV hosting gain at at most 5% curtailment. Each boundary is the minimum of 100 scenario capacities; the plotted difference of minima is not a mean effect and has no sampling-error bar. **b,** Mean paired change in PV utilisation for a fixed 500-kW installation, in percentage points, with pointwise 95% intervals from 10,000 paired bootstrap resamples of 100 scenario seeds. Sampling intervals exclude optimisation uncertainty; small signed BESS differences near the relative MIP-gap scale are not resolved benefits or physical losses. Both panels retain the actual power model at fixed GPU count, zero deadline misses and the common 1,100-kW import limit. BESS has 100-kW power and 200-kWh energy. These are full-information planning outcomes, separate from causal-controller qualification.
M157.zh: **a，**弃光不超过 5% 时，灵活减刚性的全情景光伏承载增量。各边界为 100 个情景容量的最小值；绘制的是两个最小值之差，不是均值效应，不附抽样误差线。**b，**固定 500 kW 光伏装置的平均配对利用率变化，单位为百分点，区间为对 100 个种子作 10,000 次配对自助重采样得到的逐项 95% 区间。抽样区间不包含优化不确定性；接近相对 MIP 间隙尺度的微小储能正负差异不解释为已分辨的收益或物理损失。两面板均固定 GPU 数，保留实际功率模型，要求截止时间损失为零，采用共同的 1,100 kW 进口限制。储能功率 100 kW、容量 200 kWh。这是完整信息下的规划结果，与因果控制器资格检验相区分。

M158.en: ### Figure 5 | Separate controls for GPU allocation and rigid-load power
M158.zh: ### 图 5 | GPU 分配与刚性功率的独立对照

M159.en: **a,b,** Four- and eight-hour PI tolerance lower bounds across flexible GPU allocations or unmeasured rigid-class active-power proxies, retaining 10% eligibility, the same 576-GPU installation and paired jobs. Each bound uses 100 confirmation scenarios. Lines join evaluated control settings. **c,d,** Conditional four-hour slack-participation costs at the unchanged primary offer, using all 300 confirmation ledgers, 50 independent calls per annual draw and 1-MW accounting. Crosses would indicate an offer that did not qualify. Costs are the 95th-percentile annual-net-cost decision threshold, not confidence limits. Fixed-request success and PV controls are in Supplementary Fig. 4. Rigid power proxies are not measurements of online inference.
M159.zh: **a、b，**改变灵活 GPU 分配或未测刚性类别活动功率代理时的四/八小时 PI 容忍下界，保持 10% 资格、相同的 576 GPU 设施及配对作业。每个下界使用 100 个确认情景，线连接实际检验设置。**c、d，**固定主体原承诺下，四小时自然空闲参与的条件成本，采用全部 300 份确认账本、每次年度抽样 50 个独立调用及 1 MW 会计尺度。若承诺不合格则标叉。成本为年度净成本第 95 百分位的决策门槛，不是置信限。固定请求成功率及光伏对照见补充图 4。刚性功率代理不是在线推理测量。

M160.en: ### Figure 6 | Participation thresholds for single and repeated commitments
M160.zh: ### 图 6 | 单次与重复承诺的参与门槛

M161.en: **a,b,** Required annual capacity payment per offered accounting kilowatt for four- and eight-hour single events, with 50 independently sampled calls per year. Existing slack, reserved headroom and an assumed US$0.25 per deferred GPU-h displaced-value exposure use the same physical ledger. **c,** Complete four-call programmes at 12 independent series per year: original single-event offers reused repeatedly, and smaller selected repeated offers when available. Filled circles mark passage of the pointwise confirmation criterion; crosses mark failure. None of the repeated offers was selected by the separate development rule. A conditional price does not alter either statistical outcome. **d,** Delay-price sensitivity at 10% eligibility. All panels use 1-MW proportional accounting, a US$25,000 annual site charge applied once, and 2,000 common annual draws. Thresholds make the fifth percentile of annual net value non-negative. Contract-specific failure penalties are unpriced; series independence does not simulate a continuous year.
M161.zh: **a、b，**四小时与八小时单次事件每会计承诺千瓦所需的年度容量补偿，每年独立抽样 50 次。现有空闲、预留容量，以及每推迟 GPU 小时假设 0.25 美元挤占价值的情景使用同一物理账本。**c，**每年 12 个独立序列的完整四调用方案：重复使用原单次承诺，以及有候选时采用较小已选重复承诺。实心圆表示通过逐项确认标准，叉号表示未通过。重复承诺均未通过另行开展的开发选值规则。条件价格不改变这两项统计结果。**d，**10% 资格下的延迟价格敏感性。各面板均采用 1 MW 比例会计尺度、每年仅计一次的 25,000 美元站点费用及 2,000 次共同年度抽样，门槛使年度净值的第 5 百分位不为负。合同特定失败罚金未定价；序列独立不等于连续全年模拟。

M062.en: A common job template was generated once per seed. Class-specific GPU-hours were scaled across configurations while release times, deadlines, community values and the event anchor were checked for equality. Arrivals covered seven days, followed by a 48-h clearance tail. Training deadlines were sampled at 2–6 times runtime and clipped to 6–48 h; offline-inference deadlines were 1.5–4 times runtime and clipped to 2–24 h. The sampling specification and all five baseline-service checks are recorded in Supplementary Methods 1–3. These synthetic deadlines do not establish production service permissions.
M062.zh: 每个种子只生成一次共同作业模板。各配置按类别缩放 GPU 小时，并检查释放时刻、截止时间、社区数值和事件锚点相同。到达工作覆盖七天，之后有 48 小时清空尾段。训练截止时间按运行时长的 2–6 倍抽样，并限制在 6–48 小时；离线推理为运行时长的 1.5–4 倍，限制在 2–24 小时。抽样规范和五档无响应服务检验见补充方法 1–3。这些合成截止时间不能证明生产环境授予了相应服务权限。

supplement.en: ### 1. Eligibility is an operating permission
supplement.zh: ### 1. 可延后资格是一项运行授权

supplement.en: The source audit multiplies each released execution span's requested GPU-equivalents by its uncapped duration. It retains development, other and unknown work in the denominator. Counting records would assign 79.45% to offline inference, whereas requested resource time assigns 21.52%; these are different estimands. Low priority identifies a candidate class of work, not a production deadline or permission to postpone service. At 5–20% eligibility, the common permission multiplier preserves the relative contributions of low-priority training and offline inference. The 40% case expands permission beyond that pool, while 60% explicitly changes business composition. None is a measurement of deployed demand-response eligibility.
supplement.zh: 源审计将每个公开执行区段申请的 GPU 等效数量乘以未截尾持续时间，分母保留开发、其他和未知工作。按记录数量统计，离线推理占 79.45%；按申请资源时间则为 21.52%，两者估计对象不同。低优先级只识别候选工作类别，不给出生产截止时间或推迟服务的权限。在 5%–20% 资格下，共同获准系数保留低优先级训练与离线推理的相对贡献。40% 将授权扩大至该候选池之外，60% 则显式改变业务构成。任何一档都不是已部署需求响应资格的测量值。

supplement.en: ### 2. Planning and qualification answer different questions
supplement.zh: ### 2. 规划与资格检验回答不同问题

supplement.en: A PI optimisation finds the largest feasible request for one fully known scenario. With 100 scenarios, the second-smallest optimum is the exact-binomial lower tolerance bound for 95% reliability at at least 95% confidence (achieved confidence 0.96292). A controller offer is a different object: a candidate fixed on development data and tested on 300 independent scenario seeds. The one-sided 95% Wilson lower bound must reach 0.95. The offer and PI tolerance bound use different samples and statistical constructions, so their ordering in a plot is not an information advantage. Offers are selected from a finite grid and are not continuous maxima. Notice comparisons hold the request fixed and test paired binary outcomes.
supplement.zh: PI 优化寻找一个完整已知情景中的最大可行请求。在 100 个情景中，第二小的最优值构成可靠性 95%、置信度至少 95% 的精确二项容忍下界，实际达到的置信度为 0.96292。控制器承诺是另一对象：在开发数据上固定候选，再用 300 个独立情景种子检验，其单侧 95% Wilson 下界必须达到 0.95。承诺与 PI 容忍下界使用不同样本和统计构造，图中二者的高低不代表信息优势。承诺来自有限网格，并非连续最大值。通知比较固定请求，检验配对二元结果。

supplement.en: ### 3. A repeated programme is one dependent trial
supplement.zh: ### 3. 重复方案是一次内部相关的试验

supplement.en: Four calls in one evolving queue are not four independent observations. The matched fresh comparison runs each call alone at the same clock time, then asks whether all four isolated calls passed. Both conditions therefore have the same all-four-success endpoint. Their difference estimates the consequence of call history within the specified model and schedule. A development-selected repeated candidate receives its own independent test. If no tested candidate qualifies, this is a search-grid outcome, not evidence that all positive capacities are impossible. Complete hourly series, including failures and clearance after the last call, are retained.
supplement.zh: 同一个演化队列中的四次调用不是四个独立观测。配对的新事件比较在相同时刻分别单独运行每次调用，然后检查四次是否全部通过。因此两种条件使用相同的“四次全成功”终点，其差异估计指定模型与安排下的调用历史影响。开发选出的重复候选另外接受独立检验。若测试候选均不合格，这是搜索网格的结果，不能证明一切正容量都不可能。完整小时序列保留失败轨迹及最后调用后的清空过程。

supplement.en: ### 4. PV hosting and utilisation have different denominators
supplement.zh: ### 4. 光伏承载与利用率采用不同分母

supplement.en: Hosting maximises PV nameplate at the unchanged GPU installation. The reported all-scenario boundary is the minimum of the 100 scenario capacities within each operating mode. Its gain is min(flexible) minus min(rigid), not the minimum or mean of paired differences. Fixed-PV utilisation instead divides locally used PV energy by available generation from a 500-kW installation. Its effect is reported in percentage points with paired bootstrap intervals. All current renewable programmes impose zero missed GPU-hours. They use full future information and a separately optimised dispatch; their benefit is not attributed to the causal demand-response controller.
supplement.zh: 承载优化在 GPU 设施规模不变时最大化光伏额定容量。全情景边界为每种运行方式下 100 个情景容量的最小值，其增量是 min(灵活) 减 min(刚性)，不是配对差异的最小值或均值。固定光伏利用率则以 500 kW 装置的可发电量为分母、本地使用电量为分子，效应按百分点及配对自助区间报告。当前所有可再生能源优化均要求未按期完成 GPU 小时为零。这些优化采用完整未来信息及单独优化的调度，不能把收益归给因果需求响应控制器。

supplement.en: ### 5. Controls separate allocation from eligibility
supplement.zh: ### 5. 对照区分分配与资格

supplement.en: The primary f-to-f GPU allocation rule maintains similar mean utilisation as eligibility changes. It does not make the five cases a pure one-factor experiment. At fixed 10% eligibility, the allocation controls move the flexible GPU fraction from 10% to 20% and 30%, retaining total work, hardware, releases and deadlines. The power controls retain the same allocation but change only unmeasured rigid-class active power to 150 or 225 W per GPU. Every control is tested at the original 10% configuration's selected requests; offers are not reselected after observing its results. The controls therefore compare planning potential and transfer of a fixed offer, not separately optimised controller capacities.
supplement.zh: 主体采用工作比例与 GPU 分配比例相匹配的规则，使资格变化时平均利用率相近，但这不意味着五档是纯单因素实验。在固定 10% 资格下，分配对照将灵活 GPU 比例由 10% 调至 20% 和 30%，保持总工作量、硬件、释放与截止时间。功率对照保留相同分配，只将未测刚性类别的活动功率改为每 GPU 150 W 或 225 W。各对照均采用原 10% 配置选出的请求，观察结果后不重选承诺。因此它们比较规划潜力与固定承诺的迁移表现，而非各自单独优化的控制器容量。

supplement.en: ### 6. Cost thresholds are conditional participation screens
supplement.zh: ### 6. 成本门槛是有条件的参与筛选

supplement.en: The physical ledger pairs each controlled trajectory with its own no-response baseline. Positive extra backlog accumulates waiting exposure; delayed work during events and permanently missed work remain separate quantities. Each hour is counted once across a repeated programme. Performance revenue credits only non-negative reduction capped at the request. Fixed annual site costs are applied once after proportional accounting at a 1-MW operating peak. A small offer can therefore have a high price per offered kilowatt even when its total delayed work is small. The 95th percentile of annual net cost is a risk-screening choice, not a confidence limit or observed tariff. Unqualified offers remain unqualified even if their conditional cost is low.
supplement.zh: 物理账本把每条受控轨迹与自身无响应基准配对。正的额外积压累计等待暴露；事件期间推迟工作与永久未按期完成工作保持区分。重复方案中每小时只计一次。履约收入只计非负、且以上报请求封顶的削减量。在按运行峰值比例缩放到 1 MW 会计尺度之后，每年站点固定费用只计一次。因此，即使推迟工作总量较小，小容量承诺仍可能有较高的每承诺千瓦价格。年度净成本的第 95 百分位是一种风险筛选选择，不是置信限或观察到的电价。未通过资格检验的承诺不会因条件成本较低而变成合格承诺。

supplement.en: ## Supplementary Methods
supplement.zh: ## 补充方法

supplement.en: ### 1. Source audit and permissions
supplement.zh: ### 1. 来源审计与授权

supplement.en: The local jobs_summary.parquet contained 40,522,321 execution-span records. Streaming batches of one million rows were aggregated by workload class and priority, using requested GPU-equivalents times the original duration. The total was 254,980,926.33 requested GPU-h. The audit checked the stored raw work against this product and retained all classes. The source SHA-256 was `95c91a8035197e15f29e9c1d15a9147d07b2a6959b2bb08322cb9f033b029124`. The [production study](https://www.usenix.org/system/files/osdi26-li-suyi.pdf) and [official schema](https://github.com/alibaba/clusterdata/blob/master/cluster-trace-gpu-v2026/docs/schema.md) define the infrastructure scope and execution-span fields. The reported infrastructure excludes dedicated hyperscale foundation-model pretraining clusters.
supplement.zh: 本地 jobs_summary.parquet 含 40,522,321 条执行区段记录。按每批 100 万行流式读取，以申请 GPU 等效数量乘原始持续时间，按工作类别和优先级聚合，总计 254,980,926.33 申请 GPU 小时。审计核对存储的原始工作量与该乘积一致，并保留所有类别。源 SHA-256 为 `95c91a8035197e15f29e9c1d15a9147d07b2a6959b2bb08322cb9f033b029124`。[生产研究](https://www.usenix.org/system/files/osdi26-li-suyi.pdf)和[官方字段说明](https://github.com/alibaba/clusterdata/blob/master/cluster-trace-gpu-v2026/docs/schema.md)界定基础设施范围及执行区段字段。该基础设施不包括专用的超大规模基础模型预训练集群。

supplement.en: Let s_c be the source resource-time share and l_c the low-priority batch share of class c, each relative to all offered work. For f ≤ L = Σl_c = 0.2202814, eligible work is l_c f/L. For L < f ≤ B = s_training + s_offline = 0.4094199, it is l_c + (s_c − l_c)(f − L)/(B − L). The 60% case transfers f − B = 0.1905801 from online to offline inference and makes all training and offline inference eligible. Other classes remain in the source denominator and are rigid. Full-precision shares are provided in case_definitions.json; rounding in Table 2 does not drive simulations.
supplement.zh: 令 s_c 为类别 c 的源资源时间份额，l_c 为其低优先级批处理份额，二者分母均为全部投入工作。当 f ≤ L = Σl_c = 0.2202814 时，合格工作为 l_c f/L。当 L < f ≤ B = s_training + s_offline = 0.4094199 时，为 l_c + (s_c − l_c)(f − L)/(B − L)。60% 情景将 f − B = 0.1905801 从在线转为离线推理，并使全部训练和离线推理获得资格。其他类别保留在源分母中且为刚性。完整精度份额见 case_definitions.json，表 2 的舍入数不用于驱动模拟。

supplement.en: ### 2. Paired scenarios and baseline gate
supplement.zh: ### 2. 配对情景与无响应门槛

supplement.en: Development used seeds 930000–930099 and confirmation used 960000–960299. Within each seed, a single 60%-case job template supplied the releases, deadlines and class records. Scaling only the class GPU-hours produced the remaining cases; record counts and timing were held identical. The template sampled existing low-priority training/offline job shapes, including for the explicitly hypothetical 40% and 60% cases. Total offered work was 374.4 GPU-h/h for 168 h, followed by 48 h without new arrivals. The flexible GPU count was round(576f), and rigid utilisation was 374.4(1 − f)/(576 − round(576f)). Every no-response scenario had to satisfy service and PCC limits before downstream analysis.
supplement.zh: 开发种子为 930000–930099，确认种子为 960000–960299。每个种子使用一份 60% 情景的共同作业模板提供释放、截止时间和类别记录，仅缩放各类别 GPU 小时生成其余配置，记录数及时间完全一致。模板抽取既有低优先级训练/离线作业形状，40% 和 60% 这两项明确假设的情景也沿用这些形状。总投入工作为每小时 374.4 GPU 小时，持续 168 小时，之后 48 小时无新到达。灵活 GPU 数为 round(576f)，刚性利用率为 374.4(1 − f)/(576 − round(576f))。所有无响应情景均须先通过服务与 PCC 限制，才进入下游分析。

supplement.en: Training deadlines were 2–6 times runtime, clipped to 6–48 h; offline-inference deadlines were 1.5–4 times runtime, clipped to 2–24 h. These are synthetic service rules. Single events began at one of 24 hours between 63 and 140, sampled before testing; exact starts are stored with each scenario. Community demand used a 75:25 residential/office mixed-3A profile, scaled to an 800-kW peak. A common 1,100-kW import rating and no-export rule applied to all cases. Initial development baselines under a 1,000-kW rating exceeded it in three cases at seed 930096; the common rating was raised before PI optimisation or offer selection, and the initial gate results were preserved.
supplement.zh: 训练截止时间为运行时长的 2–6 倍，限制在 6–48 小时；离线推理为 1.5–4 倍，限制在 2–24 小时。这些均为合成服务规则。单次事件在第 63 至 140 小时之间的 24 个候选时刻中抽样，测试前固定，各情景保存精确起点。社区需求采用住宅/办公 75:25 的混合 3A 曲线，缩放到 800 kW 峰值。所有情景采用共同的 1,100 kW 进口限制并禁止反送。在初始 1,000 kW 限制下，开发种子 930096 的三项配置无响应基准超限，因此在 PI 优化或选值前提高共同容量，并保存了初始门槛结果。

supplement.en: ### 3. Power conversion, queues and observations
supplement.zh: ### 3. 功率换算、队列与观测

supplement.en: Each workload ran in one- and four-GPU conditions with three repeats. After a 5-s warm-up, read-only nvidia-smi telemetry sampled board power and utilisation every second for 20 s. Repeats 1–2 supplied calibration and repeat 3 was held out. For each four-GPU repeat, readings were averaged first over time within each GPU, then across GPUs. The resulting run means were the independent units. Student t 95% intervals used the two calibration means per active class; prediction error used only the held-out repeat (Supplementary Table 1).
supplement.zh: 每种负载分别在单 GPU 和四 GPU 条件下运行，每种条件重复三次。预热 5 s 后，以只读 nvidia-smi 遥测每秒采样板卡功率和利用率，持续 20 s。重复 1–2 用于校准，重复 3 留出检验。对于每次四 GPU 运行，先对每块 GPU 的时间序列取平均，再在 GPU 之间取平均。所得运行均值才是独立单位。各运行类别的 Student t 95% 区间使用两次校准运行均值计算；预测误差仅使用留出运行（补充表 1）。

supplement.en: Facility power retained the execution class,
supplement.zh: 设施功率计算保留作业执行类别：

supplement.en:
\[
P^{\mathrm{DC}}_t=P_{\mathrm{fixed}}+\sum_c e_cX_{c,t},
\]
supplement.zh:
\[
P^{\mathrm{DC}}_t=P_{\mathrm{fixed}}+\sum_c e_cX_{c,t},
\]

supplement.en: In this expression, \(X_{c,t}\) is flexible work executed in class c during interval t, measured in GPU-h. Its coefficient is \(e_c=\mathrm{PUE}(p_c-p_{\mathrm{idle}})/(1000\Delta t)\), in kW per GPU-h. Board powers p are measured in W and \(\Delta t=1\) h. Subtracting idle power ensures that scheduled work contributes only incremental active power. Fixed facility power contains rigid-pool draw, flexible-pool idle draw and node overhead, all multiplied by PUE = 1.20.
supplement.zh: 式中，\(X_{c,t}\) 表示时段 t 内执行的 c 类灵活工作，单位为 GPU-h。其系数为 \(e_c=\mathrm{PUE}(p_c-p_{\mathrm{idle}})/(1000\Delta t)\)，单位为 kW/GPU-h。板卡功率 p 以 W 计，\(\Delta t=1\) h。扣除空闲功率后，调度工作只贡献新增的活动功率。固定设施功率包含刚性池用电、灵活池空闲用电和节点开销，各项均乘以 PUE = 1.20。

supplement.en: Jobs were stored by class and remaining deadline at one-hour resolution, up to 48 h. The labels {0, 1, 2, 3, 6, 12, 24, 48} h grouped this state for reporting and observation; they were not the queue's internal time resolution. Execution followed earliest deadline first, could not precede release and could not exceed cumulative arrivals. Work remaining when its deadline expired was counted as missed. Controlled and no-response queues received identical arrivals.
supplement.zh: 作业按类别和剩余截止时间存储，内部时间分辨率为 1 h，最长为 48 h。{0、1、2、3、6、12、24、48} h 标签用于对状态进行报告和观测汇总，并不是队列内部的时间分辨率。执行按最早截止时间优先安排，既不能早于作业到达，也不能超过累计到达工作量。截止时仍未完成的工作记为逾期。受控队列和无响应队列接收完全相同的到达工作。

supplement.en: Idle board power was 13.935625 W per GPU and node overhead was assumed to be 300 W. Online, development, other and unknown work used 300.022174 W per active rigid GPU as an engineering proxy, with 150- and 225-W controls. Rigid power was fixed at its class-weighted mean. Online latency was not separately simulated, so preserving batch deadlines is not a measured online-serving SLO test. The controller retained the existing 63-feature firm_v5 observation interface; its six-hour forecasts and queue features were causally masked. The stored compute_debt_kwh field describes the whole controlled queue. Exported excess_queue_energy_kwh explicitly subtracts the matched no-response value.
supplement.zh: 每 GPU 空闲板卡功率为 13.935625 W，节点开销假定为 300 W。在线、开发、其他和未知工作采用每活动刚性 GPU 300.022174 W 的工程代理，另设 150 W 和 225 W 对照。刚性功率固定为类别加权均值，没有单独模拟在线延迟，因此保持批处理截止时间不等于实测在线服务 SLO 测试。控制器保留既有 63 维 firm_v5 观测接口，其六小时预测及队列特征按因果信息进行掩蔽。存储的 compute_debt_kwh 描述整个受控队列；导出的 excess_queue_energy_kwh 显式减去配对无响应值。

supplement.en: ### 4. Success criteria and statistics
supplement.zh: ### 4. 成功标准与统计

supplement.en: Successful demand response required both electrical delivery and acceptable computing service. For each fixed capacity, duration, notice and controller, an episode received one binary outcome after all six criteria below were evaluated. Delivery was the non-negative reduction in point-of-common-coupling power relative to the matched baseline, capped at the request. A high mean could not compensate for an hour below the interval threshold. Peak relief was evaluated over the event and its 24-h recovery window.
supplement.zh: 需求响应成功要求同时满足电力交付和计算服务条件。对于固定的容量、时长、通知时间及控制器，每个情景在评估下列六项判据后得到一个成功或失败结果。交付量为相对于匹配基线的非负公共连接点功率削减，并以请求值封顶。较高的平均交付不能抵消某个小时低于逐时阈值的情况。削峰效果在事件及其后 24 h 恢复窗口内评估。

supplement.en:
| Criterion | Headline threshold | Operational interpretation |
|---|---:|---|
| Mean delivery | ≥0.95 | mean capped baseline-relative reduction across all event intervals divided by R |
| Minimum interval delivery | ≥0.95 | every event hour delivers at least 0.95R |
| Deadline-miss fraction | ≤0.01 | expired GPU-hour work divided by offered work |
| Rebound ratio | ≤0.25 | largest post-event excess PCC load divided by peak event reduction |
| Event-and-recovery peak relief | ≥0.50 | baseline peak minus controlled peak over the event plus 24-h recovery window, divided by R |
| Terminal-backlog fraction | ≤0.02 | positive controlled-minus-baseline backlog at the end of the 48-h tail divided by total arrivals |
supplement.zh:
| 标准 | 主要阈值 | 运行含义 |
|---|---:|---|
| 平均交付 | ≥0.95 | 所有事件时段内、相对基线且经封顶的削减量均值除以 R |
| 最小时段交付 | ≥0.95 | 每个事件小时的交付量均至少为 0.95R |
| 截止时间未完成比例 | ≤0.01 | 到期未完成的 GPU-hour 工作量除以提供的工作量 |
| 反弹比 | ≤0.25 | 事件后最大超额 PCC 负荷除以事件峰值削减量 |
| 事件及恢复窗口削峰 | ≥0.50 | 在事件及其后 24 h 恢复窗口内，基线峰值减受控峰值，再除以 R |
| 终端积压比例 | ≤0.02 | 48 h 尾段结束时受控减基线积压的正值除以总到达工作量 |

supplement.en: Failure attribution retained combined labels rather than assigning only the first failed criterion. Mean and interval failures could occur together, and delivery failures could coincide with rebound or window-relief failures. Recovery-time non-resolution was a separate diagnostic, not an additional certificate criterion.
supplement.zh: 失败归因保留组合标签，而不是仅记录首先失败的标准。平均交付与区间交付可以同时失败，交付失败也可以伴随反弹或窗口峰值缓解失败。恢复时间未能在窗口内确定属于独立诊断，不是额外的容量认证标准。

supplement.en: For 100 PI optima, binomial inversion selected the second order statistic at q = 0.95 and confidence 0.95. For controller testing, a one-sided 95% Wilson interval used z = 1.6448536. Development and confirmation applied the same lower-bound threshold of 0.95. Each condition contained 100 development or 300 confirmation seeds; extra notices and calls did not create additional independent seeds. Notice comparisons used exact paired McNemar tests with Holm correction across 20 contrasts. Repeated-minus-fresh differences used 10,000 paired bootstrap resamples of 300 seeds. Renewable mean differences used 10,000 paired resamples of 100 seeds. These intervals and qualifications are pointwise, apart from the declared notice-test correction.
supplement.zh: 对 100 个 PI 最优值，二项分布反演在 q = 0.95、置信度 0.95 时选取第二顺序统计量。控制器检验的单侧 95% Wilson 区间使用 z = 1.6448536，开发与确认采用相同的 0.95 下界门槛。各条件含 100 个开发或 300 个确认种子；额外通知和调用不增加独立种子数。通知比较使用配对精确 McNemar 检验，对 20 项比较作 Holm 校正。重复减新事件的差异采用 300 个种子的 10,000 次配对自助重采样，可再生能源均值差异采用 100 个种子的 10,000 次配对重采样。除声明的通知检验校正外，区间与资格均为逐项结论。

supplement.en: ### 5. Causal controller and development correction
supplement.zh: ### 5. 因果控制器与开发阶段修正

supplement.en: The six-hour robust MPC retained its historical-arrival uncertainty envelope, objective weights and release-only queue information. Development exposed a dimensional mismatch in the former recovery guard: it allowed an overshoot of 0.25R, whereas rebound was evaluated relative to actual peak delivery, which could be as low as 0.95R. The revised guard uses 0.25 × 0.95R, along with the existing event-and-window-relief envelopes. When float32 conversion would cross an electrical limit, actions are rounded towards zero. All success criteria remain unchanged. Regression checks cover the delivered-power rebound denominator, event-boundary rounding and unchanged actions outside event/recovery windows. This is a new controller version, not a reinterpretation of the original locked certificate.
supplement.zh: 六小时鲁棒 MPC 保留其历史到达不确定性包络、目标权重和仅含已释放作业的队列信息。开发阶段发现原恢复保护中的换算不一致：允许反弹 0.25R，但评估以实际最大削减量为分母，而该值可能低至 0.95R。修正后的保护采用 0.25 × 0.95R，并保留事件及窗口峰值削减限制。当 float32 转换将越过电气边界时，动作向零舍入。所有成功标准不变。回归检查覆盖实际交付分母、事件边界舍入，以及事件/恢复窗口之外动作不变。这是新的控制器版本，不能重新解释为原锁定证书。

supplement.en: Each duration tested 50%, 75%, 90% and 100% of its development PI lower bound. The largest candidate meeting the development Wilson criterion was frozen before confirmation. After the final controller correction, 300 previously unexamined seeds were reserved for confirmation; earlier original-controller and intermediate development outputs were retained as diagnostics. No confirmation outcome was used to choose a smaller replacement offer.
supplement.zh: 各时长检验开发 PI 下界的 50%、75%、90% 和 100%，将满足开发 Wilson 标准的最大候选在确认前冻结。最终控制器修正后，保留此前未查看的 300 个种子用于确认；更早原控制器和中间开发输出保存为诊断。不使用确认结果另选较小替代承诺。

supplement.en: ### 6. Repeated programmes
supplement.zh: ### 6. 重复方案

supplement.en: Four event starts were 63 + j(H + G), j = 0, 1, 2, 3, for (H,G) = (4,8) or (8,12) hours. Development tested 25%, 50%, 75% and 100% of the selected single-event offer without assuming monotonic success. Confirmation tested the prespecified original single offer repeated, plus four single-call counterfactuals at matching clock times. The protocol additionally provided for testing a development-selected repeated offer if one qualified; none did. The no-response reference was the same full-capacity schedule in every paired comparison. The experiment covers two declared programmes, not every recovery gap or a continuous-year guarantee.
supplement.zh: 四次事件起点为 63 + j(H + G)，j = 0、1、2、3，其中 (H,G) 为 (4,8) 或 (8,12) 小时。开发检验所选单次承诺的 25%、50%、75% 和 100%，不假定成功率单调。确认检验重复使用的预设原单次承诺，并配有四个相同时刻的单调用反事实。协议还规定，如开发选出重复候选则另外确认；实际没有候选通过开发门槛。每项配对比较都使用相同的全容量无响应参考调度。实验覆盖两种声明的方案，未穷尽所有恢复间隔，也不构成连续全年保证。

supplement.en: ### 7. Renewable planning
supplement.zh: ### 7. 可再生能源规划

supplement.en: Each configuration used its actual power model at scale one. PV hosting maximised rated PV capacity with curtailment ≤5%, zero deadline misses, terminal backlog ≤2%, imports ≤1,100 kW and no exports. Fixed-PV operation used 500 kW and lexicographic objectives: service, local PV use, grid import, then battery throughput. PV-use tolerance was 10<sup>−5</sup> kWh. BESS had 100-kW charge/discharge power, 200-kWh energy, charge and discharge efficiency 0.95, and initial/terminal state of charge 50%. Binary exclusivity prohibited simultaneous charge and discharge. The first 100 confirmation seeds were paired across rigid/flexible operation and both BESS conditions. All feasibility statuses and missed work were retained; an all-scenario capacity is not reported from a filtered subset.
supplement.zh: 每种配置均在尺度一使用自己的功率模型。光伏承载最大化额定容量，要求弃光 ≤5%、截止时间损失为零、末期积压 ≤2%、进口 ≤1,100 kW 且禁止反送。固定光伏运行使用 500 kW，按服务、本地光伏利用、电网进口、电池吞吐依次作词典序优化，光伏利用容差为 10<sup>−5</sup> kWh。储能充放电功率 100 kW、容量 200 kWh，充放电效率均为 0.95，初始/末期荷电状态 50%。二元互斥禁止同时充放电。前 100 个确认种子在刚性/灵活运行及两种储能条件之间配对。保留全部可行性状态与未完成工作，不从筛选后的子集报告全情景容量。

supplement.en: HiGHS 1.15.1 retained its default relative MIP gap 10<sup>−4</sup> and absolute gap 10<sup>−6</sup>; only solver thread count was changed. The lexicographic lock on PV use is distinct from the primary optimisation gap. Small signed BESS utilisation contrasts can lie within this numerical resolution (roughly 0.01 percentage points when most PV is used). They are retained rather than clipped to zero, but are not interpreted as a physical loss or a resolved benefit. Bootstrap intervals describe scenario sampling only. The numerical-precision audit records the solver version and options.
supplement.zh: HiGHS 1.15.1 保留默认相对 MIP 间隙 10<sup>−4</sup> 和绝对间隙 10<sup>−6</sup>，只改变求解线程数。光伏利用的词典序锁定与第一阶段优化间隙不同。储能利用率的微小正负差异可能落在这一数值分辨尺度内（当大部分光伏被使用时约为 0.01 个百分点）。数据保留这些差异，不将其裁为零，也不解释为物理损失或已分辨的收益。自助区间只描述情景抽样，数值精度审核记录求解器版本与选项。

supplement.en: ### 8. Orthogonal sensitivity controls
supplement.zh: ### 8. 正交敏感性对照

supplement.en: Four controls around 10% eligibility were specified before their outcomes were examined: flexible GPU allocation 20% or 30%, and rigid-class active-power proxy 150 or 225 W. Other inputs, seed identities and event times were unchanged. Each control had 300 no-response gates, 100 PI scenarios at both durations, 300 fixed-offer tests at both durations, and 100 paired renewable scenarios. Its economic ledger used the same fixed requests. These selected controls and the five eligibility scenarios do not constitute a global sensitivity analysis over simultaneous variation in all model parameters.
supplement.zh: 在查看结果前，围绕 10% 资格声明四个对照：灵活 GPU 分配 20% 或 30%，刚性类别活动功率代理 150 W 或 225 W。其余输入、种子和事件时刻不变。各对照含 300 项无响应门槛、两个时长各 100 个 PI 情景、两个时长各 300 个固定承诺测试，以及 100 个配对可再生能源情景。经济账本采用相同固定请求。这些选定对照与五档资格情景不构成所有模型参数同时变化的全局敏感性分析。

supplement.en: ### 9. Complete ledgers and economic sensitivity
supplement.zh: ### 9. 完整账本与经济敏感性

supplement.en: From the first event through episode end, delay exposure was the sum of positive paired excess backlog times the one-hour interval. Incremental energy was the signed controlled-minus-baseline PCC energy. Deferred work summed positive execution shortfalls during event hours; it did not automatically imply lost work. Each repeated series contributed every hour once. The source tables retain incremental deadline misses and terminal backlog even when a programme fails.
supplement.zh: 从首次事件到情景结束，延迟暴露为正的配对额外积压乘一小时时长后求和；增量能耗为有符号的受控减基准 PCC 电量。推迟工作为事件各小时正的执行短缺之和，并不自动代表工作损失。每个重复序列中每小时只计一次。源表保留增量截止时间损失与末期积压，即使方案失败也不剔除。

supplement.en: Single-event annual draws sampled 50 complete confirmation episodes; repeated draws sampled 12 complete four-call series. Two thousand common bootstrap draws were used at each price setting. Physical quantities and the offer were multiplied by 1000 divided by each configuration's own operating peak; the US$25,000 annual site charge was then added once. The required payment was max(0, the 95th percentile of net annual cost divided by offered accounting kW). Prices were US$0.10/kWh for electricity, US$50/MWh for capped delivered energy and US$0.005/GPU-h/h for waiting. All 300 trajectories were retained regardless of success.
supplement.zh: 单次年度抽样选择 50 个完整确认情景；重复年度抽样选择 12 个完整四调用序列。各价格设置采用相同的 2,000 次自助抽样。物理量和承诺同乘以 1000 除以各配置自身运行峰值，然后仅添加一次每年 25,000 美元站点费。所需补偿为 max(0，年度净成本的第 95 百分位除以会计承诺千瓦)。电价为每 kWh 0.10 美元，封顶交付电量每 MWh 50 美元，等待每 GPU 小时每小时 0.005 美元。保留全部 300 条轨迹，不按成功筛选。

supplement.en: Reserve costs annualised 0.15 abstract reserved PCC-side kW per offered kW, at US$2,500 per reserved kW, 8% discount, four-year life, 10% salvage and 3% annual operation and maintenance. This is not a GPU procurement quotation or wear model. Separate assumed displaced-value exposures of US$0.25 and 0.50 per deferred GPU-h were evaluated; only the former is the main illustration. Sensitivity grids covered waiting prices 0, 0.001, 0.005 and 0.01; fixed site costs 10,000, 25,000 and 50,000; displaced values 0, 0.25, 0.5 and 1; missed-work prices 0, 0.25 and 1; and reserve lives 3–6 years. Contract-specific non-performance penalties were not priced. The original price-source register is retained in the archive; these inputs remain scenarios rather than observed operator accounts.
supplement.zh: 预留成本按每承诺千瓦对应 0.15 个抽象 PCC 侧预留千瓦年化，每预留千瓦 2,500 美元、折现率 8%、寿命四年、残值 10%、年运维 3%。这不是 GPU 采购报价或磨损模型。另评估每推迟 GPU 小时 0.25 和 0.50 美元的假定挤占价值，正文只用前者作示例。敏感性网格包括等待价格 0、0.001、0.005、0.01，站点固定费 10,000、25,000、50,000，挤占价值 0、0.25、0.5、1，未完成工作价格 0、0.25、1，以及预留寿命 3–6 年。未给合同特定的不履约罚金定价。原价格来源登记表保存在归档中；这些输入仍是情景，不是观察到的运营商账目。

Utilisation uses a fixed 500-kW PV installation; means and pointwise paired bootstrap intervals are in percentage points. All current renewable solutions are retained and checked for zero deadline misses. The corresponding conditional mean hosting effects are separately available in Source Data.
supplement.zh: 各承载容量为弃光 ≤5% 时全部 100 个确认情景的最小值。利用率采用固定 500 kW 光伏，均值及逐项配对自助区间以百分点计。保留全部当前可再生能源解，并核对截止时间损失为零。相应的条件平均承载效应另列于源数据。

supplement.en: ### Supplementary Table 7 | Single-event and complete-programme participation screens
supplement.zh: ### 补充表 7 | 单次与完整方案参与筛选

supplement.en: All payments are US$ per offered accounting kW-year at a proportional 1-MW operating peak. Single events use 50 independent calls/year; repeated programmes use 12 independent four-call series/year. The site charge is US$25,000 once yearly. The displacement illustration assumes US$0.25 per deferred GPU-h. The repeated-pass column applies the confirmation Wilson criterion only; the separate development rule selected no repeated candidate. Conditional costs do not change either outcome. All price-grid rows and failed-trajectory service losses are retained in Source Data.
supplement.zh: 所有补偿单位为每会计承诺 kW 每年的美元，按运行峰值比例缩放到 1 MW。单次为每年 50 个独立调用，重复为每年 12 个独立四调用序列，站点费每年只计一次 25,000 美元。挤占示例假设每推迟 GPU 小时 0.25 美元。重复通过列仅采用确认集 Wilson 标准，另行开展的开发规则没有选出重复候选。条件成本不改变这两项结果。全部价格网格及失败轨迹的服务损失均保留在源数据中。

supplement.en: ### Supplementary Table 8 | Orthogonal allocation and rigid-power controls
supplement.zh: ### 补充表 8 | 正交分配与刚性功率对照

supplement.en: All controls retain 10% eligibility and the same work. g20/g30 change flexible GPU allocation to 20%/30%; rigid150/rigid225 change only unmeasured rigid-class active power to 150/225 W. Payment units and annual assumptions match Table 7. Full renewable and paired economic controls are provided in Source Data.

The main economic comparison uses the reference prices and reports the 95th percentile of net annual cost. Delay/site/displacement prices are crossed; missed-work prices are varied at the reference delay/site setting with no displacement charge; reserve life is varied separately. These are scenario inputs, not empirical distributions or a joint global uncertainty model. No actual GPU procurement price, ageing hazard or contract-specific failure tariff is inferred.
supplement.zh: 主体经济比较采用参考价格，报告年度净成本第 95 百分位。延迟、站点和挤占价格交叉；未完成工作价格在参考延迟/站点设置且无挤占收费时变化；预留寿命另行变化。这些是情景输入，不是经验分布或联合全局不确定性模型，未据此推断真实 GPU 采购价、老化风险或合同特定违约价格。
